openingMessage: Every crew in the field comes home today. That's not a goal — that's the standard. Here's how we hold it.
openingWhy: A man goes down at a thief hatch and every good hand's first instinct is to run to him. That instinct — no air, no test — is how one man down becomes three. The standard exists so that nobody's best instinct becomes the worst decision of his life.
leadershipThought: Inspect, communicate, execute — in that order, every time. Not because someone is watching. Because the load doesn't care about shortcuts.

todaysChallenge: If something goes sideways today, call it in straight — no polish, no blame. Admit it, log the lesson on your OWL form, and make sure the next crew hears it.
todaysChallengeSubtext: “When you make a mistake, there are only three things you should ever do about it: admit it, learn from it, and don't repeat it.” — Bear Bryant
